name: Tom
nameVi: Tôm sú, tôm sắt, tôm đất
summary: Sài Gòn Giải Phóng calls tôm the seafood visitors liked most in 2014. Most of it is tôm sú, from the sea or from ponds. Tôm sắt has a hard shell. Tôm đất has a soft clear shell and chewy sweet meat. Tôm gạch son, the story says, is best around lunar months 3 and 4. A cook was not printed.

howToEat: The story does not name grill, steam, or a sauce. When to order it is Check on arrival, except the lunar months 3 and 4 line for tôm gạch son.
